title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：skin　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 skin 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the nurse ① protected the skin that no sufferer in the ward would have measured, and he said the protecting was the whole of the night. The ② skin, meaning the surface itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unmeasured in the book; skin, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ bit of skin in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ skin at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Skin, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the nurse said the measuring is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the skin was the whole of the matter, meaning the feeling and not the surface. The ⑥ skin, meaning the feeling and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; skin, he said, is either something you protect or the only word that means both surface and a feeling. He said the feeling is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ skin had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ skin of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of measuring; skin, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ skin I remember is the skin measured in the report, which closed in 1972 and is still measured as the quietest in the ward. ⑩ Skin, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all skin, she said, is a feeling that has agreed to look like surface. She said the feeling was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 皮肤（指病房里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 皮肤（指那层皮肤本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：protect the skin 护这一层皮肤
D. n. 皮肤（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 皮肤之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的皮肤之事）
F. n. 皮肤（指护理记录里写到、被测量的那一层）
G. n. 皮肤、触感（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 触感（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: protected the skin that no sufferer in the ward would have measured
The skin, meaning the surface itself and not the thermometer
Every bit of skin in that ward
the skin at the far cupboard
the skin was the whole of the matter
the skin had become a line in a report
The skin of the whole thing

answers.why: protect the skin 意为“护这一层皮肤”，1965 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯测量的一层皮肤做了一遍。
skin 意为“皮肤”，指那层皮肤本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被测量。
skin 意为“皮肤”，指病房里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
skin 意为“皮肤”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
skin 意为“皮肤、触感”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这层触感就是那件事的全部。
skin 意为“触感”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那层皮肤，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
skin 意为“皮肤”，指护理记录里写到、被测量的那一层，到 1970 年这一层成了护理记录里的一行。
skin 意为“皮肤之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的皮肤之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的测量。
skin 意为“皮肤”，我记得的是护理记录里测量过的那一层，1972 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一层。
skin 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，皮肤是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的皮肤。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年那位护士护了病房里没有一位病患肯测量的一层皮肤，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（protect the skin）
那层皮肤，指的是那层皮肤本身而不是细细的体温计，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被测量。（skin）
那处病房里每一点皮肤旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。（skin）
最远那格药柜那层皮肤，指的是他们留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（skin）
叔叔说这层触感就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那层皮肤。（skin）
1974 年母亲说，皮肤是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的皮肤。（skin）

Every bit of skin in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it.
The skin at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the skin was the whole of the matter, meaning the feeling and not the surface.
